goal_context: Continue toward a complete Bominal-grade Oyatie mockup. This slice addresses a current-state audit finding: the topfold still led with generic operations/payroll metrics instead of the user-defined FD-001-on-Oyatie-Cloud product thesis.

current_state_audit.finding: After prior slices, the dashboard contained FD-001/Oyatie Cloud language deeper in Work Hub and Ontology, but the first viewport still lacked a cohesive topfold substrate proof command board.

product_direction_applied.user_directive: Oyatie will build a hyperscaler-grade cloud substrate and dogfood all FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads on that substrate. FD-001 product delivery remains the master-plan product goal; Oyatie Cloud is the substrate that proves the platform can host real production tenants.
product_direction_applied.ui_interpretation: The first command-center viewport now states that FD-001 remains the product goal and Oyatie Cloud is the substrate proof, then maps FD-001 workloads to cloud cells, deployment gates, policy, and evidence routes.

change_summary: Inserted a new topfold Substrate Proof command board immediately after core metrics and before the Action Inbox, making FD-001 tenant workload dogfooding on Oyatie Cloud visible before operational queues.
Added four proof cards for product goal, substrate, tenant lens, and readiness, with real product language instead of generic dashboard copy.
Added a two-column workload-to-cloud-cell map: Workflow, Messenger, Mail, and Community on the FD-001 side; cell-us-east-2, kr-seoul-1, GitOps promotion, and Evidence Spine on the Oyatie Cloud side.
Added local interactive routes from the proof board into Cloud Ops, Workflow, Evidence, Messenger, Mail, Community, FinOps, Deployment Gates, Finance, Identity, and Catalog.
Added SSR/static rendering and CSS for a Bominal-grade dense command surface while preserving local-only/no-backend semantics.

differences: Bominal corporate command center remains a reference for density, grid rhythm, and operational command language; this topfold is not a clone because it carries Oyatie Cloud and FD-001 dogfood semantics.
The first viewport is now more product-thesis heavy than Bominal because the user explicitly re-centered the mockup around hyperscaler-grade substrate proof.
The full mockup goal remains active; this verdict covers the topfold cohesion/product-direction gap only.
suggestions: Continue a final holistic audit for any remaining mismatched labels or stale generic payroll-only language before declaring the complete mockup done.
Consider later making the Substrate Proof board collapsible if vertical density becomes too high, but keep it expanded for mockup/product demo fidelity.
visual_verdict.reasoning: Browser evidence shows the topfold now starts with metrics followed immediately by a dense, interactive product thesis board. The board connects FD-001 workloads, Oyatie Cloud cells, GitOps deployment gates, and evidence receipts, and interactions route to the correct local product surfaces.

ssr_smoke.note: Initial empty replies can occur during container compile/restart; final response contained the SSR substrate proof markup.
